notes: Each test case simulates a realistic coding task to validate docs-context skill behavior.
Fixtures (files/) represent starting project state; the eval runner should copy them into the agent's workspace before each run.
The agent under test has access to Read/Write/Edit/Bash/Glob/Grep tools and the docs-context skill.
Observable signals per run: (1) transcript (Skill invocations, tool calls, replies); (2) filesystem diff of docs/; (3) sync summary text if written.
Run each test twice: with docs-context skill available / without it. Compare pass rates and token cost.
Priority 1 (P1) tests cover the highest-risk, highest-signal behaviors: net-delta auto-trigger, reverse rollback sync, no-op on design, slug-confirmation, multi-module Upstream/Downstream sync.

Schema note (v1.2): docs/modules.md is now docs/modules/<bcu-slug>.md (one file per Business Capability Unit). docs/decisions.md is now docs/decisions/ADR-<slug>.md (one file per decision; old decisions deleted, not marked Superseded). No README/index files under either directory.

evals.prompt: Add a Bulk Refund capability: a POST /orders/bulk-refund endpoint that accepts a list of order IDs and triggers refunds via RefundService. Use the standard pattern.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the BCU Splitting Decision Flow. Bulk Refund and the existing Refund BCU share the same downstream gateway, state machine, and team — answer Q1/Q2/Q3 leans toward 'merge'. So the agent extends docs/modules/refund.md (the existing BCU) with a new bulk-refund implementation entry under its `## Implementation` section, OR — only if the user signals clear independent-evolution criteria — creates a separate `bulk-refund.md` BCU file. The agent does NOT silently create a duplicate BCU and does NOT modify the unrelated Create Order BCU.
evals.setup_note: Tests the BCU splitting decision: when a new operation (Bulk Refund) is similar to an existing BCU (Refund), the conservative-merging principle says extend the existing BCU first. Distinct from eval 6 (which creates a whole new BCU file for a clearly-separate capability). Validates that the BCU Splitting Decision Flow is run and that unrelated BCUs are not disturbed.
assertions: A POST /orders/bulk-refund endpoint implementation exists in the order-service source files after the run.

Either docs/modules/refund.md gains a bulk-refund entry under its `## Implementation` (preferred per conservative merging), OR a new docs/modules/bulk-refund.md BCU file is created (only with explicit splitting rationale).
The change includes at minimum the Implementation entry; Flow and Upstream/Downstream are updated when affected. Section-omission rule applies — sections with no content are not added.
The updated/created BCU file's `## Implementation` lists the HTTP API entry (POST /orders/bulk-refund) AND references RefundService.
The pre-existing 'Create Order' BCU file (docs/modules/create-order.md) is unchanged (no edits to its Implementation/Flow/etc. sections).
No new file under docs/modules/ was created (the change goes into the existing order.md).
The Doc Sync Summary references the BCU file (refund.md or bulk-refund.md) that was updated/created.

The agent did NOT silently write a Double-typed discount_rate field to source code.

The final outcome is one of: (a) the agent asked the user to confirm overriding coding.md, OR (b) the agent generated the compliant Long-typed version, OR (c) the agent stopped and waited for clarification — NOT silent violation.

fixture_setup_instructions.how_to_create: Fixtures can be assembled as minimal Java/Go/Node projects. Suggested: copy a small real subproject, strip to 10-20 files, seed docs/ per templates in skills/docs-context/assets/templates/. For BCU files, follow the BCU template (assets/templates/module.md) — one file per Business Capability Unit. For ADRs, follow the minimal-frontmatter template (assets/templates/decision.md). Do NOT create README files under docs/modules/ or docs/decisions/.
